questions.question: What is the purpose of Psalm 78 (a maskil of Asaph)?
options: To joyfully celebrate the wedding of the king and his radiant young bride
To teach the next generation God's deeds and law so they set their hope in God
To record and preserve the names of all the kings who ruled over Judah
To pour out a long and very bitter complaint against the cruel and unjust enemy
questions.answer: To teach the next generation God's deeds and law so they set their hope in God

questions.question: What did the people repeatedly do despite God's miracles?
options: Trusted, obeyed, and kept his law
Sinned, rebelled, and forgot his works
Feared, served, and sought his face
Praised, blessed, and told his deeds
questions.answer: Sinned, rebelled, and forgot his works
